# MeTenk

> MeTenk builds free, privacy-first productivity tools for the web. Our flagship product is a browser extension combining a Pomodoro focus timer, to-do list, and reminders for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. All data stays local on the user's device — we do not sell or upload user data.

MeTenk (https://metenk.com/) is the official website for the MeTenk productivity extension and related tools by an independent team focused on safety, practicality, minimalism, and efficiency.

## Languages

The site is available in English, Simplified Chinese (简体中文), Traditional Chinese (繁體中文), Spanish (Español), Brazilian Portuguese (Português do Brasil), and Japanese (日本語). Every language has its own crawlable URL — English at the root and the others under `/zh/`, `/zh-tw/`, `/es/`, `/pt-br/`, and `/ja/` — linked together with `hreflang` alternates. On the English root pages the language follows the visitor's browser setting; on a language-specific page the URL determines the language. Visitors can switch at any time via the language control at the bottom of the footer. The `lang` attribute of each page reflects the language being displayed.

## Products

- [MeTenk - Task Timer](https://metenk.com/): Free browser extension for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. Pomodoro timer, to-do list, focus statistics, focus reminders, and side panel support. Local-first privacy.
- [Clock Max](https://metenk.com/clockmax.html): Reminder-first Chrome extension (提醒神器). One-time, daily, weekly, weekday/weekend, monthly (a chosen date or the last day), yearly, and custom reminders at any time of day, plus a world clock, countdown timers and stopwatch, and a built-in to-do list. Free, no account, all data stored locally on the device.
